featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 整合关键词对标、风格库、二创写作与独立小红书工具，保留 SEO 版统计和版本发现服务。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Integrate benchmark research, style libraries, rewriting and the separate Xiaohongshu tool while preserving SEO telemetry and version discovery.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 小红书使用独立应用身份，独立公共服务登记前显示未配置。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Use a separate Xiaohongshu application identity; public services remain unconfigured until independently registered.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 重复采集时保留已经读取的互动数据，未提供的指标继续显示为缺失。
bugFixes.en-US: Preserve previously observed engagement metrics during recollection and keep unavailable values marked as missing.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 批量生成缺少 AI 服务、凭据或提示词时，明确显示出错阶段与配置原因。
bugFixes.en-US: Show the affected stage and configuration cause when batch generation lacks an AI service, credential or prompt.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 增加关键词对标采集、公开互动数据筛选及选定作品二创。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add keyword benchmark collection, public engagement filters and writing from selected works.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 增加多作者风格库、可编辑内置提示词和一键应用风格。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add a multi-author style library, editable built-in prompts and one-click style application.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 提供独立的 SEO 文章与小红书笔记工具，沿用用户自行配置的 AI API。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Provide separate SEO article and Xiaohongshu note tools using user-configured AI APIs.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 首次启动默认中文，Windows 安装向导使用简体中文。
bugFixes.en-US: Use Chinese on first launch and Simplified Chinese in the Windows installer.
